note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated Indian customs shipping-bill records with B/L numbers exist for Dubai/UAE (2026-01-29, B/L 9187738, HS 90181100 for 'CLARITY PC ECG WITH STANDARD ACCESSORIES' — this matches the declared HS 901811), plus Kenya and Panama lanes in Feb 2026. Note the declared HS 901811 is corroborated by the 90181100 line, while the company's other lines are 90181990 (EEG/EMG/patient monitors) and 84141090 (vacuum pumps, import side). The 2026-02-26 rows are re-imports of exhibition goods from Dubai (MEDICA 2025), i.e. return of own equipment, not a sale — do not count those as export revenue. Import side is also active (Gardner Denver Thomas Wuxi pumps, Jialichuang Hong Kong components, EMG Octopus units from Romania/Italy), so the entity is a manufacturer_trader profile: own-brand ECG/EEG assembly plus distribution of imported electromyographs. Registered address per customs data: C-84, Industrial Area, Phase VII, Mohali, Punjab (a second address Plot-1687A Sec-82 JLPL, Mohali also appears). No CIN/PAN or revenue figure is public in the sources read — left null. Domestic (India) supply evidence could not be checked because the search backend was unavailable; this is a gap to close, not a negative finding.
